500.title: Server error
500.description: Sorry, we encountered a problem while processing your request. Please try again in a moment.

404.title: Page not found
404.description: Sorry, we couldn't find the page you're looking for. The URL might be incorrect or the page may have been removed.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.description: This page was never opened on this device. Trips you've opened before are still there.
